employees.basis: total workforce excluding the Chinese joint ventures

source.label: Annual Report 2025, Business Development, total workforce
source.quote: At the end of 2025, the Volkswagen Group's total workforce excluding the Chinese joint ventures had a total of 602,659 employees, which was 1.9% fewer than at the end of 2024.

source.label: Consolidated Financial Statements 2025, note 42 Personnel expenses (€ million)

notes: Employees: the year-end workforce excluding the Chinese joint ventures (602,659), because the consolidated personnel expense covers only consolidated companies; including the Chinese joint ventures the workforce was 662,942 (628,893 active employees, plus employees in the passive phase of partial retirement and trainees). Payroll: note 42's total personnel expenses (€49,080 million: wages and salaries, social security and post-employment and other benefit costs), in billions of EUR.
